messages.security.notice: Plugin permissions and signatures: all plugins run in the same JVM as the application and inherit the operating-system permissions of the current user. They can read or modify files, access the network and database, start processes, and even terminate the application. A signature proves the package publisher and content integrity only; it is not a security review or sandbox. Install only plugins you trust.
